description: This Java abstract class 'FlexibleStringExpander' provides mechanisms to parse, cache, and evaluate string expressions containing embedded expressions, scripts, and nested expressions, supporting features like currency formatting and nested expression evaluation within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander
classes.description: Abstract class for parsing and evaluating string expressions with embedded variables, scripts, and nested expressions, supporting caching and localization features.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Internal class for cache key representation based on string content.

classes.name: SimpleKey
classes.description: Cache key implementation using a character array for exact string matching.

classes.name: OffsetKey
classes.description: Cache key implementation using character array with offset and length for substring matching.

classes.name: ConstSimpleElem
classes.description: Represents a constant string segment in the expression.

classes.name: ConstOffsetElem
classes.description: Represents a constant string segment with offset and length.

classes.name: CurrElem
classes.description: Represents a currency expression segment, formats currency based on evaluated code.

classes.name: Elements
classes.description: Container for multiple expression fragments, concatenates their evaluated results.

classes.name: ScriptElem
classes.description: Represents a script expression, evaluates Groovy or other scripts.

classes.name: NestedVarElem
classes.description: Represents a nested expression, evaluates after resolving inner expressions.

classes.name: VarElem
classes.description: Represents a simple variable expression, evaluates using UelUtil.

methods.name: containsConstant
methods.description: Checks if the expression contains a string constant.

methods.name: containsExpression
methods.description: Checks if the expression contains an evaluatable expression.

methods.name: containsScript
methods.description: Checks if the expression contains a script element.

methods.name: expandString
methods.description: Evaluates the expression with given context, locale, and timezone, returning a string.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached instance of FlexibleStringExpander for a given expression string.
